lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is Telluride Town Council's November 17 meeting, where the 2027 budget and property tax levy come to a vote — and Council will also take a second crack at an ordinance that would suspend the Open Space Fund's cut of Real Estate Transfer Tax revenue for the year. San Miguel County's Planning Commission digs into proposed changes to the Affordable Housing Impact Mitigation Fee on the 12th, a wonky-sounding item with real consequences for whether workforce housing actually gets built. SMART's board also convenes to act on three resolutions, including an amendment to the Executive Director's employment agreement and a gondola project update worth keeping an eye on.

notable.stake: Proposed fee changes could reshape how workforce housing gets built countywide.
